visual.general_description: Three-panel figure: a portable frontal chest radiograph (a) and two axial chest CT slices (b, c).
visual.detailed_description: Panel a is a grayscale portable chest radiograph with printed UPRIGHT, PORTABLE and AP text and bilateral patchy opacities. Panels b and c are axial lung-window CT slices at upper and lower levels showing patchy abnormality in both lungs, with a dense homogeneous region on the left side of the image in each slice. Panel letters (a), (b) and (c) are printed below the images.

panels.general_description: Frontal portable chest radiograph with patchy opacities in both lungs.
panels.detailed_description: Grayscale frontal chest radiograph with printed text at the upper corners reading UPRIGHT (upper left), PORTABLE and AP (upper right), a ring-shaped marker beside a four-character number at the left edge, and a second ring-shaped marker at the top right. Both lung fields show patchy, hazy opacities. On the left side of the image the lower hemithorax is more homogeneously dense with a curved outline, and a small bright curved object and thin curved linear lines overlie that side. On the right side of the image the lung shows patchy opacity. Ribs, clavicles, spine and soft-tissue outline of the chest are visible. No arrows or other annotations.

panels.general_description: Axial chest CT at upper level with patchy abnormality in both lungs.
panels.detailed_description: Axial chest CT slice in lung window. Both lungs show diffuse patchy reticular and ground-glass-like opacity with visible airway and vessel markings. On the left side of the image the lung shows patchy opacity with some darker areas, and a dense homogeneous region lies posteriorly and laterally against the chest wall, with a few air-containing airways leading into it. On the right side of the image the lung shows fine diffuse reticular opacity. The heart and mediastinum are centrally placed, with the sternum anteriorly and a vertebra posteriorly. No printed labels, arrows or text.

panels.general_description: Axial chest CT at lower level with a large homogeneous density in one hemithorax and patchy opacity in the other lung.
panels.detailed_description: Axial chest CT slice at a lower level, in lung window. On the left side of the image a large homogeneous soft-tissue density fills most of that hemithorax posteriorly and laterally, leaving a small aerated lung region with airway markings anteriorly. On the right side of the image the lung is patchy with ground-glass-like opacity and visible airways posteriorly. The heart is central, the sternum is anterior and a vertebra is posterior. A small ring-shaped marker lies outside the body at the upper left of the image. No printed labels or text.
